events.name: BAD INDIAN - A NATIVE AMERICAN COMEDY SHOW
events.info: BAD INDIAN: A NATIVE AMERICAN COMEDY SHOWwith Joshua Danger EmersonGrowing up, Natives were the funniest people in Joshua Emersons life but when he started pursuing comedy as a career, there were hardly any Natives to be found. So he decided to produce Bad Indian with a simple goal: to develop and showcase Indigenous comedy talent, built on a simple premise: Natives are funny. Since then, Joshua has produced Bad Indian at clubs and festivals all over the country, including being the first and only Native showcase at Netflix is a Joke Fest. Be apart of the movement. boxOfficeInfo.phoneNumberDetail: Please note, this is NOT the same location as Talking Stick Resort & Casino. The main number for Talking Stick Resort Amphitheatre is (602) 254-7200.
boxOfficeInfo.openHoursDetail: The box office at Talking Stick Resort Amphitheatre is open on-day-of-show only. We look forward to seeing you at our next show at Talking Stick Resort Amphitheatre.
boxOfficeInfo.acceptedPaymentDetail: Cashless payments: All points of sales will only accept credit, debit or mobile pay (such as Apple Pay or Google Pay). The box office will only accept credit or debit.
boxOfficeInfo.willCallDetail: ALL WILL CALL (Band / Media / Radio Station / Ticketmaster) will be located at the WEST Box Office ONLY! The West Box Office is located through Gate 3 off Encanto Blvd. between 79th and 83rd Ave. Please have a PHOTO ID, the CREDIT CARD the tickets were purchased on, and your CONFIRMATION number.

venues.parkingDetail: Premier Parking can be purchased when you purchase your concert tickets or on event day through Gate #6. Premier parking is sold online and at the entrance to the Premier parking lot. For Premier Parking, enter Gate 7 on 79th Ave. For General Parking, enter Gate 1 on 83rd Ave or Gate 8 on 79th Ave. For ADA Parking, enter Gates 3 or 6 on Encanto Blvd. Please be advised that parking is limited. You must have a parking placard or ADA license plate to park. Uber pickup and drop off is located on Palm Ln , near 83rd Ave. There is a Uber pick up zone located on Palm Ln. For EZ Out Parking enter through Gate 2
venues.accessibleSeatingDetail: Accessible seating is available in Sections 100,201,202,203,204 & 205. The companion seats are bolted down seats. The wheelchair seats are just a space where a wheelchair may be placed. Limited Mobility seating is available in Sections 101,203,205, & 304. These seats are located near an aisle. Sight and Hearing impaired seating is also available.

generalInfo.generalRule: ITEMS ALLOWED to be brought into the venue include: •Clear bags, clear backpacks, and clear totes no larger than 12" x 6" •Small, non-clear bags and fannypacks - no larger than 6" x 9" •Factory Sealed Water Bottle - Up to one gallon unfrozen per person, or empty reusable water bottle to fill inside* •Blankets* •Personal Misting Fan - Empty upon arrival •Sunscreen / Bug Spray (non-aerosol) •Cameras (without a detachable lens only) •E-Cigarettes & Vape Pens (Can only be used in Lawn & Plaza areas) *for select shows. ITEMS NOT ALLOWED to be brought into the venue include, but are not limited to: •Lawn Chairs •Weapons of any kind •Large Bags / Backpacks / Luggage / Computer Bags / Camera Bags •Outside food or drink - except factory sealed water •Aerosol Sunscreen •Alcohol •Coolers of any kind •Illegal drugs / substances •Glass containers •Selfie Sticks •Laser pointers •Glow sticks •Animals (except service animals) •Fireworks •Strollers •Heavy Chairs
